dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast, low-intensity perimeters with jagged edge geometry, transitioning through a sharp gradient to high-intensity internal centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, dark, asymmetrical pixel clusters concentrated in the mid-to-posterior dorsal region, characterized by solid low-intensity cores lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal section form a scalene triangle, with the longest edge oriented approximately parallel to the visible longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: A series of high-intensity specular highlights (near-white pixel values) form a segmented linear pattern along the inferior lateral boundary.
